chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'opal hat pin 9ct', 'antique hat pin opal gold', 'Whitby jet brooch', 'antique jet beaded brooch oval', 'French jet faceted brooch', 'dress studs onyx boxed'. viewing_check: Check hat pin head and shaft for any 9ct/375 stamp and test the rose-gold disc; look at opal quality (play of colour, solid vs doublet); examine the black brooch beads for glass versus jet (warm to touch, light, resin-like, carved vs faceted glass; look for chips and pin condition); check the studs for stamps (white metal vs silver).
